fusions.name: Staghorn Rake
fusions.desc: A raking horn strike that deals 7 damage and makes the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Run Aground
fusions.desc: Slams your calcified bulk into every enemy within 3 tiles, dealing 28 rock damage. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 6% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Reef Shelter
fusions.desc: Raises a living reef 4 tiles around where you stand. For 10 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally inside it. Every ally within 5.5 tiles makes it 10% stronger, up to 4.

fusions.name: Slow Accretion
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 8. At 8 they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 6% of your maximum health per stack. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
